interaction.user_prompt:
[tool_result Bash] or moved through a symlink at the destination.

**Moving** renames within a filesystem. Across filesystems (to a USB drive, for example) Twin
copies, flushes the copy to disk, and only then removes the source. If the copy fails, the source
is untouched and the partial copy is removed.

When a batch finishes, both panes reload. A failed entry does not stop the others; each failure
goes to the error log. There is no progress display yet: a large copy runs in the background and
the panes update when it is done.

## Errors

Twin never fails silently. A failure shows in red in the status bar for five seconds; when a
copy or move had several failures, the toast names the first and counts the rest. Every error is kept in
the error log (Alt+L) with the time it happened, up to the last 500, until Twin quits.

The log opens in place of the active pane, newest entry at the bottom:
